layout_contract.group: full module boundary, stretch rows, no phantom items
layout_contract.compact: only explicit data-qt-align=compact for justified local combination
layout_contract.capacity: wrappable font budget + intrinsic media ratio + actual parent; never rendered height feedback
layout_contract.media: qt-t-media-group aligns media slots/captions; screenshots contain + original size
layout_contract.review: Internal source records only in draft/refine review; no automatic public citations or audit footer. Reader-facing attribution is authored.

expressions.purpose: 生产链、工具辅助与终点成果
成长阶段直接承接成果
主题与行动共同构图，H5装饰收小
expressions.use_when: 先确定主题主信息，标题角色随阅读任务；品牌/眉题不重复占据核心信息位置

expressions.purpose: 起点/变化/作品证据相邻
expressions.use_when: 有可比较的起点与结果，且证据支持变化；否则选择action-artifact或其他实际关系

expressions.purpose: 左右图文、主图细节、双三媒体协调
